Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.model.Event
public class Event extends Object
Represents a volunteer event created by a coordinator. Dates are stored as ISO-8601 strings in SQLite; this class exposes them both as strings (for FXML binding) and as LocalDate.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event(int id, String title, String description, String eventDate, String eventTime, String location, int volunteersNeeded, int createdBy)
      Creates an event from every field at once.

      Prefer builder(): with eight positional arguments, five of them strings, it is easy to pass the date and time in the wrong order without the compiler noticing. This constructor is kept so existing code and tests keep working.

      Parameters:
      id - the database id, or 0 if not yet saved
      title - the event title
      description - what volunteers will be doing
      eventDate - the date, as YYYY-MM-DD
      eventTime - the start time, as HH:mm
      location - where the event is held
      volunteersNeeded - how many volunteers the coordinator wants
      createdBy - the id of the coordinator who created it

    • builder

      public static Event.Builder builder()
      Starts building an event one named field at a time.

      Example: 

      Event event = Event.builder()
        .title("Beach clean-up")
        .date("2026-10-20")
        .time("09:00")
        .location("Manly Beach")
        .volunteersNeeded(10)
        .createdBy(coordinatorId)
        .build();
      Returns:
      a new builder with every optional field empty
